prompt: Repair the lifetime handling of borrowed tool-registry contexts. A parent owns a ToolRegistry and a live background shell job. A child receives a restricted registry through the existing filtered() API, and may create another filtered view. When the child finishes and disposes those borrowed views, the parent's background job is unexpectedly terminated and the runtime stops accepting background work. Make child cleanup safe while preserving the actual owner's ability to terminate its jobs and release its resources. Preserve filtering and execution behavior. Add a regression test demonstrating the bug and your fix in tests/test_eval_regression.py. You may edit only minicode/tooling.py and tests/test_eval_regression.py. Run the public compatibility tests and your regression tests before finishing.
